query: Here's our Figma flow for bulk-inviting users by CSV. Can you break it into user stories with acceptance criteria for Jira? Owners and Admins can invite, Members can't.
expected_behavior: Writes an epic with outcome, metric (baseline to target) and in/out of scope
Splits vertically using SPIDR or workflow/role techniques into small stories with specific roles and outcome-based 'so that' clauses
Gives 3-8 Given/When/Then ACs per story plus a UX checklist covering loading, empty, error, partial and no-permission states, exact error copy, keyboard/focus, responsive and analytics events
Includes a role/permission matrix with the denied experience for Members, and lists open questions with owners

query: Is this story ready for sprint? 'As a user, I want a better dashboard that is fast and intuitive, with export, filters and sharing.'
expected_behavior: Runs the INVEST check and explains which letters fail (vague role, no outcome, not small, not testable)
Rewrites it with a specific role and real outcome, and splits export, filters and sharing into separate stories
Replaces 'fast' and 'intuitive' with measurable, observable acceptance criteria
Applies the Definition of Ready checklist and states what is missing (design links, states, copy, permissions)

query: I need a one-page design brief for redesigning SSO setup for admins, and a handoff checklist for when the designs go to engineering.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/briefs-and-handoff.md and follows the brief template: problem with evidence, users and roles, goals, success metrics with baseline/target/guardrail, scope and non-goals, risks and assumptions, open questions
Names multiple enterprise roles (admin, IT identity engineer, end user) and stakeholders such as security, CS and support
Provides a per-story handoff note covering links, components, tokens, all states, keyboard and focus, copy, analytics events and edge cases
Marks unknowns as 'Unknown - owner - date' rather than omitting them
